description: Permanent record of commercial logic bugs resolved in GLV SAT. CI reads this file to prevent regressions.

errors.title: PRICE_TABLE fallback contaminating PDF price
errors.root_cause: GlvPDF.jsx read doc.pricePerKg as fallback; doc.pricePerKg is written at save time from PRICE_TABLE lookup, not from CommercialEngine unit price
errors.fix: pricePerKg = engineUnitPrice only — CommercialEngine is sole source. doc.pricePerKg never used in PDF rendering.

errors.title: LIVE_ANIMALS formula (head×avgWeight) contaminating FROZEN_MEAT
errors.root_cause: avgWeight default (45 kg) was injected into non-livestock quantity calculations when category was not isolated
errors.fix: isLiveAnimalRow guard isolates head×weight formula to LIVE_ANIMALS only. engineQty = 0 for live animals.

errors.title: Container type hardcoded to Reefer 20FT
errors.root_cause: Container type was hardcoded; no selector available to agents
errors.fix: ContainerTypeSelector added with 10 options. Default per category from CATEGORY_DEFAULT_CONTAINER.

errors.title: FRUIT_PRODUCTS media binding showing sheep/livestock images
errors.root_cause: mediaBinding.js had no product-level exclusion layer; only branding exclusions existed
errors.fix: isProductCategoryCompatible() added with PRODUCT_CATEGORY_EXCLUSIONS per category

errors.title: Profile validation loop blocking agents (cargo required but SUPER_ADMIN controlled)
errors.root_cause: completed flag required cargo+phone+country+signature, but cargo is set by SUPER_ADMIN — agents could never reach completed=1
errors.fix: completed = (phone && signature_b64) only. validateDoc.js short-circuits all profile checks when completed===1.

errors.title: MT unit quantity showing raw value in PDF (54 MT displayed as 54 kg)
errors.root_cause: totalKg in GlvPDF.jsx used engineQty directly without MT→kg conversion
errors.fix: totalKgDisplay = isMT ? engineQty * 1000 : engineQty. Added Cantidad box for raw unit display.

errors.title: FROZEN_MEAT showing Número de Cabezas / Peso Promedio from LIVE_ANIMALS
errors.root_cause: Grid guards used isLivestock(doc.product) string-match — matched legacy product names like 'Animales Bovinos Vivos' when category was actually FROZEN_MEAT
errors.fix: Grid guards replaced with isLiveAnimalRow (CommercialEngine category check). Never uses doc.product string.

errors.title: Scattered category conditionals causing repeated cross-category contamination
errors.root_cause: Category-specific logic was hardcoded in multiple files (CommercialEngine, GlvPDF, mediaBinding) with no shared source of truth — each fix required touching multiple files
errors.fix: DynamicCommercialEngine created at src/engines/categoryEngine.js. All category predicates, container defaults, cargo types, PDF text routing, and media config centralized there.

errors.title: isLivestock / isGrain string-match functions controlling PDF text blocks
errors.root_cause: isLivestock() checked doc.product string for 'ovino','bovino','animal','vivo' — fragile against product name changes and missed new categories like FROZEN_POULTRY
errors.fix: PDF text routing replaced by pdfTextKey derived from getCategoryEngine(firstCdRow.category).pdfTextKey — category enum drives text selection, not product name strings.

errors.title: Missing categories in mediaBinding (LENTILS, CHICKPEAS, ANIMAL_FEED, OILS, EGGS)
errors.root_cause: CATEGORY_RULES and PRODUCT_CATEGORY_EXCLUSIONS in mediaBinding.js only covered 8 of 13 product categories — new categories fell through to generic matching
errors.fix: Added CATEGORY_RULES and PRODUCT_CATEGORY_EXCLUSIONS for LENTILS, CHICKPEAS, ANIMAL_FEED, OILS, EGGS. All 13 categories now covered.

errors.title: Container types hardcoded as inline array in CommercialEngine.jsx
errors.root_cause: CONTAINER_TYPES array was defined inline in CommercialEngine.jsx with no specs (payload, volume, classification). Changes to container definitions required editing component files.
errors.fix: containerEngine.js created as single source of truth. CommercialEngine imports CONTAINER_TYPES from containerEngine. Specs (maxPayloadMT, volumeCBM, liquid, livestock, bulk) now available to all consumers.

errors.title: No category behavioral profile — V4 unit layers and pricing modes scattered across components
errors.root_cause: No single file defined which pricing modes, packaging types, container types, or unit layers apply per category — each component had its own interpretation
errors.fix: categoryProfiles.js created. Each category now has a full V4 profile: categoryType, supportsPackaging, supportsLivestock, pricingModes, allowedUnits, allowedContainers, transportModes, pdfLayoutProfile.

errors.title: No isolated PDF context — stale document state contaminating successive PDF renders
errors.root_cause: GlvPDF.jsx computed context inline from mutable doc prop with no isolation boundary — rapid successive renders could carry over previous document's country, port, or media selection
errors.fix: pdfContextResolver.js created. resolvePDFContext(doc, cdRows) returns a frozen snapshot — no globals, no stale props, deterministic output.

errors.title: Container label hardcoded as '× 20'' in CommercialSummaryPanel and AggregateSummary
errors.root_cause: CommercialSummaryPanel displayed '${containers} × 20'' regardless of selected container type. AggregateSummary also used hardcoded '× 20''. Users selecting Reefer 40FT, ISO Tank, etc. still saw '20'' in the commercial summary output.
errors.fix: getContainerLabel(containerType) from containerEngine used in CommercialSummaryPanel. AggregateSummary displays 'contenedores' (generic plural). Hardcoded '20'' string eliminated.

errors.title: Liquid/packaged products forced into kg-only pricing with no sale unit selector
errors.root_cause: OILS, FRUIT_PRODUCTS, COLOMBIAN_EXOTIC_FRUITS had no way to declare pricing per liter, per box, per jerrycan, or per container. All products defaulted to perKg formula with no UI path to change it. PDF always showed 'Price/kg' regardless of actual commercial agreement.
errors.fix: LiquidPackagingEngine V5: BULK_INDUSTRIAL_OPTIONS, RETAIL_CONSUMER_OPTIONS, COMMERCIAL_SALE_UNITS added. calcShipmentValue extended with commercialUnit switch (perKg/perMT/perLiter/perBox/perUnit/perDrum/perJerrycan/perBottle/perPallet/perContainer). Box Engine added (qty×unitsPerBox×netWeightPerUnit×price). PDF Section 2 shows packaging type, presentation size, units per box, commercial sale unit. LIVE_ANIMALS formula completely isolated and untouched.

errors.title: IncotermSelector price label hardcoded '/kg' regardless of commercial sale unit
errors.root_cause: IncotermSelector showed 'Precio CFR / kg' hardcoded. When commercialUnit was perBox or perLiter, the price label was still '/kg', confusing agents about which unit the entered price corresponds to.
errors.fix: IncotermSelector accepts commercialUnit prop. Price label dynamically shows COMMERCIAL_SALE_UNITS.find(u=>u.id===commercialUnit)?.abbr. Defaults to '/kg' only when no commercialUnit is selected.

errors.title: LiquidPackagingEngine layers mixed — presentation, size and sale basis shown without visual separation
errors.root_cause: LiquidPackagingEngine V5 displayed packaging mode, type, size, and commercial sale unit in a flat sequential layout with no visual separation. Agents could not distinguish which layer they were configuring: 'Litro/Liter' appeared in the wrong layer context, creating commercial logic confusion.
errors.fix: LiquidPackagingEngine restructured into 4 numbered visual layers with distinct backgrounds: Layer 1 (Presentation/Packaging Type), Layer 2 (Presentation Size — retail only), Layer 3 (Box/Carton Engine — conditional), Layer 4 (Commercial Sale Basis). Added perIBC and perFlexitank to COMMERCIAL_SALE_UNITS. Retail bottle types use button grid instead of dropdown. Auto-calculates netWeightPerUnit from presentation size selection.

prevention_ci_manifest.description: Patterns that CI checks on every PR. Failures block merge.

errors_v7_1.title: PRESENTATION SIZE MISMATCH — pouchConfig.presentationSize and sku.presentationSize are independent states, causing divergence between Pouch Spec block and SKU breakdown table in PDF
errors_v7_1.root_cause: PouchConfigPanel sets pouchConfig.presentationSize; each SkuCard sets sku.presentationSize independently. Two separate React state trees with no synchronization. PDF reads pouchConfig.presentationSize for spec block header and sku.presentationSize for SKU rows — can show different values (e.g. 1000ml vs 900ml).
errors_v7_1.fix: resolveNormalizedPresentationSize(pouchConfig, skus) added to packagingEngine.js — single canonical source. When PouchConfigPanel selects a size, all SKUs sync via onPouchSizeChange propagation. ProductRowPanel computes normalizedPresentationSize and includes it in onChange payload. GlvPDF reads firstCdRow.normalizedPresentationSize for spec block. VAL-025 blocks PDF if mismatch is detected.

errors_v7.title: No flexible pouch export format — Doypack/Stand Up Pouch not addressable as export route
errors_v7.root_cause: EXPORT_FORMAT_OPTIONS had RETAIL_DOYPACK but no granular pouch types (Pillow, Stand Up, Spout, Gusset, Side Seal, Bag In Box). Film structure, seal type, certifications, and carton config had no dedicated engine.
errors_v7.fix: PouchPackagingEngine.js created with POUCH_TYPES, FILM_STRUCTURES, POUCH_SIZES, MASTER_CARTON_CONFIG, PALLET_CONFIG, CONTAINER_UTILIZATION, OEM_CAPABILITIES. 7 new POUCH group entries in EXPORT_FORMAT_OPTIONS. PouchConfigPanel added to ExportFormatEngine. perPouch/perCarton added to COMMERCIAL_SALE_UNITS.

errors_v7.title: No freight efficiency comparison between pouch and PET — agents could not quantify logistics advantage
errors_v7.root_cause: No container utilization data per format/size combination existed. Agents had no data to present CIF competitiveness or pouch density advantages to buyers.
errors_v7.fix: CONTAINER_UTILIZATION table and calcFreightEfficiencyRatio() added. Pouch density ~30k–60k units/40HQ vs ~22k PET. calcPouchLogistics() computes totalUnits, totalLiters, pallets, estimatedContainers per SKU.

errors_v7.title: Media engine had no pouch/flexible packaging category tags — liquid categories showed generic oil images for pouch documents
errors_v7.root_cause: resolveMediaContext() had no awareness of export format. OILS category showed generic oil barrel/drum imagery even when the product was a flexible stand-up pouch for retail.
errors_v7.fix: resolveMediaContext() accepts exportFormat opt. POUCH_MEDIA_TAGS merged into context when isPouchFmt. POUCH_MEDIA_EXCLUSIONS prevent livestock/grain/frozen contamination.

errors_v6.title: Single-SKU limitation — no way to quote multiple presentation sizes in one product row
errors_v6.root_cause: Each product row had one presentation size, one packaging type, one price field. Exporters offering 900ml + 1L + 2L in the same shipment had to create multiple documents or use incorrect quantities.
errors_v6.fix: Multi-SKU engine V6: 1–5 SKU cards per product row, each with independent packaging type, presentation size, units/carton, carton weight, sale basis, price, qty. calcMultiSkuSummary aggregates all SKUs. PDF Section 2 shows professional SKU breakdown table. CommercialSummaryPanel shows unit context (BOXES, UNITS, KG NET).

errors_v6.title: Export Format field absent — presentation was conflated with loading format
errors_v6.root_cause: Presentación field described both the bottle/carton size AND the loading format (Flexitank, Retail PET, etc.) in the same field. Industrial routes (Flexitank, ISO Tank) had no explicit export format selector — agents had to infer from packaging type.
errors_v6.fix: Export Format field introduced. EXPORT_FORMAT_OPTIONS: FLEXITANK, ISO_TANK, IBC_1000L, DRUM_200L, JERRYCAN_20L, RETAIL_MIXED, RETAIL_PET, RETAIL_TETRA, RETAIL_DOYPACK, CUSTOM. isRetailExportFormat() gates MultiSkuEngine vs industrial fields. INDUSTRIAL_SALE_UNITS + SKU_SALE_UNITS separate the two pricing paths.
